craft_notes: Sthāyin: tongue-seal (the h-utterance — hoccāra kept). Rows: row 3 (utterance→calm dissolves). Close: dissolves (pralīyate — the block's verbs will all be dissolve-family: dissolve/fades/wastes). Rejected: 'pranava-hum' — killed: h kept as h (the single letter IS the practice); 'yoga-nidrā' — no: calm kept.

lines: h-utterance made by mind — in calm dissolves.
